title: AIC Tactics fields in an AI's aic object
description: Authoring aid for extension fields. Ordinary AIC fields remain valid. The Lua provider is the runtime validator; it also checks cross-field dependencies and that each recruitment row totals 100.

provocation.description: How much pressure qualifies as an attack on this AI.

LossPower.description: Military losses caused by an opponent.

WindowTicks.description: How long an incident remains relevant.

Strength.description: Native strength state for this recruitment opportunity.

recruitRow.description: First matching row replaces this recruitment choice's four shares. All four must total 100.

RecruitPolicy.description: Optional compatibility switch. Native uses the game's recruiter; WeightedRoles uses four shares. Authoring a sortie share activates WeightedRoles without this field.

RecruitProbSortieDefault.description: Sortie share at normal strength. Combine with the existing Defense, Raid and Attack shares to total 100.

RecruitProbSortieWeak.description: Sortie share when weak; the four weak shares must total 100.

RecruitProbSortieStrong.description: Sortie share when strong; the four strong shares must total 100.

RecruitConditions.description: Optional situation-specific shares; first matching row wins. Requires WeightedRoles.

DefRecruitComposition.description: Preserve the proportions of DefUnit1..8 while recruiting defenders. Requires WeightedRoles.

RecruitInitialDefenseMonths.description: Months to prefer filling defense before raids and the main army; 0 removes the wait. Requires WeightedRoles. Default 6.

UntilDefeated.description: Keep the selected opponent across attacks while valid.

AttackTargetPolicy.description: Choose an opponent. New choices hold one target for the current attack by default; an object can keep it until defeated. Inherit uses TargetChoice.

AttackTargetCommitment.description: Older AIC field retained for compatibility. New AICs set target duration inside AttackTargetPolicy.

AttackActivation.description: Optionally wait for a qualifying attack before starting offensive armies or raids.

ProvocationRules.description: Shared retaliation thresholds for older AICs, threat-based recruitment or AfterProvocation. Direct use requires all four values.

AttackPreparation.description: Optionally prepare one next wave at home while the current army attacks.

RaidTargetPolicy.description: Building choice for raids. RandomNearby draws a reachable building, then clears nearby buildings before drawing again.

RaidGroupCount.description: Split the existing total raid force into up to four groups; does not recruit extra troops.

RaidMinGroupSize.description: Minimum troops before a raid group leaves.

RaidFocus.description: Building category or category percentages. Percentages may total at most 100; the remainder targets any building. Requires Opportunistic or RandomNearby.

RaidRiskTolerance.description: How much nearby defense a raid accepts.

RaidEnemyScope.description: Raid the main opponent or any enemy; does not change the main army's target.

SafeSiegePlacement.description: Protect friendly units at siege construction sites. Module default ON; advanced siege policies require it.

ActualSiegeResourcePayment.description: Require configured materials and gold before construction; module default OFF.

CoordinatedSiegeHarassment.description: Gather siege engines and approach reachable targets together; module default OFF.

SiegeHarassMinEngines.description: Preferred number of ready harassment engines before departure; module default 3.

LargerSiegeForces.description: Repeat the existing assault equipment mix while unassigned attack engineers and native capacity remain; module default OFF.

SiegeForceMax.description: Optional cap on active and pending assault equipment. 0 lets available engineers determine size; module default 0.
